description: Task 6: localise help content via per-locale directories. Add locale-aware path resolution to the ff-help ContentLoader (probe help/<locale>/ then English help/ as fallback) with NO change to parsing or the topic model, and wire the ff-desktop shell to load help for the active ui.locale and re-resolve on a ui.locale hot-reload so subsequently displayed topics use the new locale. Topic_Key and cross-reference keys stay unlocalised. Satisfies Req 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 6.4. Independent of FEAT-002, but depends on FEAT-001's ui.locale reload callback wiring for the hot-reload path.
steps: In crates/ff-help/src/content_loader.rs add `pub fn resolve_help_directory_for_locale(&self, locale: &str) -> Option<PathBuf>`: for each base in search_paths probe base.join(locale) first, then base itself (English fallback); return the first existing. For locale "en" this resolves the same base directory load_all would pick. Add `pub fn load_all_for_locale(&self, locale: &str) -> Result<ContentLoadResult, HelpError>` that resolves via the locale-aware method then reuses the existing discover_files + ContentParser pipeline UNCHANGED (Req 6.1, 6.3). Keep load_all() as-is. If the file would exceed 400 non-test lines, split the locale-aware functions into a content_loader_locale.rs sibling (rust-standards split order).
Do NOT touch discover_files, ContentParser, HelpTopic, or TopicKey -- Topic_Key and cross-references come from parsed content, not the path, so they stay unlocalised (Req 6.3).

In crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/construct.rs, read ui.locale from config_handle and call loader.load_all_for_locale(&locale) instead of load_all() when building the help registry. With the default en the resolved content is identical (Req 10.2). If this pushes construct.rs over 400 non-test lines, factor the help-registry build into a helper fn (e.g. build_help_registry_for_locale in shell/help.rs) and call it from construct.rs.

Hot-reload (Req 6.4): extend the ui.locale reload path from FEAT-001 (either add a second on_locale_reload registration or chain into the existing closure) so that on a locale change the shell re-resolves the help search paths and reloads the registry, so subsequently displayed topics use the new locale. Keep the registry Arc swap consistent with how the shell already holds it (state_groups.rs HelpState).
acceptance_criteria: ff-help tests: locale_directory_resolves_when_present (temp help/fr exists -> picks it), locale_directory_falls_back_to_english_when_absent (no help/fr -> picks help), english_locale_resolves_base_directory_unchanged (locale en -> same dir load_all picks) -- all pass (Req 6.1, 6.2, 10.2).
Existing resolve_help_directory_* and discover_files_* tests remain unchanged and green.

The shell builds the help registry for the active locale; a focused test on the factored helper shows the topic set switches between a temp help/ and help/fr/ when the locale changes (Req 6.4). If a full headless shell harness is unavailable, the test targets the extracted helper and the FEAT findings record why.
No change to Topic_Key, cross-reference keys, parsing, or the topic model (Req 6.3).

findings: DESIGN DECISION (hot-reload, Req 6.4), grounded in the code read during planning: both shell/state_groups.rs HelpState.registry AND help_context.rs HelpContextPanel.model hold Arc<HelpTopicRegistry> CLONES that share ONE inner Arc<RwLock<HashMap<TopicKey,HelpTopic>>>. HelpTopicRegistry has NO clear() method, and register_file_topic only inserts/upgrades (never removes), so re-loading a different locale into the SAME registry would leave stale previous-locale topics. Chosen approach (no new mechanism, Req 10.1): add an additive `pub fn replace_file_topics(&self, topics: Vec<HelpTopic>)` to crates/ff-help/src/registry.rs that takes the write lock, removes all FileBased-source topics (leaving CommandRegistry/Plugin topics untouched to preserve their priority), then bulk-inserts the new set -- mutating the SHARED inner map so BOTH Arc holders observe the swap WITHOUT reconstructing the panel. The ui.locale reload closure (chained onto the existing one in main.rs that calls i18n_bootstrap::install_catalogue) re-resolves the help dir for the new locale via load_all_for_locale and calls replace_file_topics on the shell-held registry Arc. This keeps the Arc identity stable (the context_panel's clone stays valid) -- the cleanest fit for the existing shared-Arc model. The reload closure needs a clone of the registry Arc and the config handle; capture them in main.rs where both are in scope, same pattern as the existing _locale_reload_handle.
